params.digest: The new approved image digest (non-zero to enable spending).

checkDeadman().details: Fail-closed automation: if the owner goes dark past `deadmanSeconds`,      any observer can halt spending.

hashRequest((uint256,address,uint8,uint1.details: `keccak256(abi.encode(block.chainid, address(this), req))`. The chain id      and this contract's address are mixed in for domain separation: a      signed request cannot be replayed on another chain or against a      different PolicyModule deployment. The off-chain evaluator must mix in      the same two values.

returns._0: The 32-byte digest to sign / recover against.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

recordSpend(uint256,uint64).details: Re-asserts the caps after updating (defence in depth) so the window and      cumulative invariants hold at the accounting layer too, independent of      {validate}. Fails closed if frozen/lapsed or the nonce is already burned.

params.amountMinor: The amount that was transferred, in minor units.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revoke().details: Monotonic: the epoch can only ever increase. There is no setter that      lowers it.

params.tier: 1, 2, or 3. (0 = unknown is the implicit default and is blocked.)

params.tier2CapMinor_: Tighter per-tx cap for tier 2 counterparties.
params.tier2MaxPriceBandZ_: Maximum absolute price-band z for tier 2.

softFailBitmask((uint256,address,uint8,u.details: Mirrors the soft-predicate logic in {validate} exactly. Returns 0 for      tier-1 and tier-3 counterparties, which never run the soft predicates.      Used by the account to report *why* a payment was held.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

validate((uint256,address,uint8,uint16,u.details: Hard predicates revert with their named error. Soft predicates set a      hold flag but do not revert. Returns {Status.APPROVED} if all pass, or      {Status.HELD} if all hard pass but a soft predicate failed. Reverts      closed if the account is frozen or the deadman has lapsed.

account().notice: The single RekhaAccount permitted to call {recordSpend}.

agentSigner().notice: Agent key share. Its signature is predicate 1.

attestCoreImage(bytes32).notice: Sets/rotates the approved core-code image. Owner only.

checkDeadman().notice: Anyone may call. Freezes the module if the heartbeat has lapsed.

constructor.notice: Deploys and fully configures the policy authority.

coreImageDigest().notice: Approved core-code image. Predicate 3 fails closed if this is zero.

coreSigner().notice: Core key share. Its signature is predicate 2.

guardian().notice: Guardian may revoke (raise the epoch) but nothing else.

hashRequest((uint256,address,uint8,uint1.notice: The canonical digest both key shares sign.

heartbeat().notice: Owner heartbeat that keeps the deadman switch from firing.

permittedCategories().notice: Category allow-list as a 256-bit bitmap indexed by `categoryCode`.

policyHash().notice: Hash of the current tunable policy; bumped by {setPolicy}.

recordSpend(uint256,uint64).notice: Records a completed spend: burns the nonce and advances the window         and cumulative counters. Callable only by the linked account.

revocationEpoch().notice: Monotonic revocation counter. Every valid request must carry the         current value; raising it instantly staleness-kills all in-flight         requests signed under the old epoch.

revoke().notice: Raises the revocation epoch, instantly invalidating every in-flight         request signed under the old epoch. Owner or guardian only.

revokeCoreImage().notice: Instantly distrusts the running core by clearing its approved image.         Every subsequent {validate} fails predicate 3 until re-attested.

setAccount(address).notice: Links the single RekhaAccount allowed to call {recordSpend}. Owner only.

setCounterpartyTier(address,uint8).notice: Sets a counterparty's tier in the registry. Owner only.

setPolicy(uint256,uint256,uint64,uint256.notice: Updates the tunable policy knobs and bumps `policyHash`. Owner only.

setSigners(address,address).notice: Rotates the agent and core signer key shares. Owner only.

softFailBitmask((uint256,address,uint8,u.notice: Which soft predicates (9/10/11) `req` fails, as a bitmask.

usedNonces(uint64).notice: Burned nonces. A nonce is consumed on an actual spend.

validate((uint256,address,uint8,uint16,u.notice: Re-verifies every predicate for `req` in the fixed order.
